description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

HubIQ is a staffing technology platform that consolidates operational data to help staffing leaders understand profitability and make informed decisions. The Full-Stack Software Engineer will build its multi-tenant platform, including dashboards, system integrations, and an AI agent, and deliver features from database to user interface for customers.
Software Engineer building multi-tenant staffing platforms, margin dashboards, ATS/payroll/accounting integrations, and AI-agent features

Responsibilities:
• You’ll join the engineering team building HubIQ’s multi-tenant platform: dashboards that show staffing leaders their true margins, integrations with ATS/payroll/accounting systems, and HubAI, our AI agent
• You’ll own features end to end, from database to UI, and ship to real customers after features go through our testing processes

Requirements:
• Shipped React apps (components, state, hooks)
• Real projects in TypeScript, or strong experience in another typed language
• A backend-as-a-service (Supabase highly preferred; Firebase, Appwrite, Neon, or similar is fine)
• SQL and relational databases (Postgres a plus)
• Built and consumed REST APIs (SOAP/XML a plus)
• Git and GitHub workflow: branches, pull requests, resolving conflicts
• Actively uses Claude Code or OpenAI Codex and multi-agent workflows can describe specifically how
• Experience: Junior to mid (roughly 1-3 years of professional experience, or equivalent personal/open-source work). Strong web projects outweigh years

Preferred:
• Multi-tenant SaaS experience (data isolation between customers)
• Data, analytics, or reporting features (dashboards, charts, warehouse queries)
• Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Zod, Vitest/Jest
• Cloud deploys (Cloudflare, Vercel, AWS)
• Git worktrees, or builds their own tooling and automation to move faster
